definitions.gloss: phone upgrade; device change; model change
definitions.explanation: The process of switching to a new phone or device model while keeping the same carrier contract and phone number.

examples.japanese: そろそろ{機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}しようかな。
examples.english: Maybe it's time to upgrade my phone.

examples.japanese: {機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}のとき、データ{移行|いこう}を{忘|わす}れないで。
examples.english: Don't forget to transfer your data when you change phones.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}モデルに{機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}したら、バッテリーの{持|も}ちが{良|よ}くなった。
examples.english: After upgrading to the latest model, the battery life improved.

notes:
{機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう} is commonly abbreviated as {機変|きへん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}する (to upgrade/change phones)
- {機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}{手続|てつづ}き (phone upgrade procedure)
- {機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}キャンペーン (phone upgrade campaign)

FORMS:
- {機種|きしゅ}{変更|へんこう}する (to change device models)

RELATED WORDS:
- データ{移行|いこう}: data transfer
- {乗|の}り{換|か}え: carrier switch
- {新規|しんき}{契約|けいやく}: new contract
